thread:
samir: starting a short experiment: 'co-sell clearinghouse' to reduce claim thrash. idea = single intake, automated mapping, then a 3-step handoff semaphore (ACK -> Claim -> Confirm). Rules draft below.

kelly: love the semaphore idea. can you explain ACK vs Claim?

samir: ACK = team sees intake and marks 'reviewing' (no ownership). Claim = formal ownership (writes si_owner). Confirm = AE or field-advocate accepts shared ownership for execution. windows: SMB=24h, MID=48h, ENT=72h.

maria: mapping sieve: try canonical_domain match -> parent_company id -> crm fuzzy match. log decisions in mapping_audit. if ambiguous -> auto-queue to partner-ops for manual adjudication.

ops-bot: [bot] Intake received: IntegratorNova / BetaWorks -> lead queued. Route=marketplace, account_tier=mid.

hw-team: note: hardware-origin leads should hit hw-triage first. hw can tag `hw_needs_si` to flip into clearinghouse claim flow.

kelly: escalation: if no Claim after window -> ping @oncall-partnerops + post summary to #partner-escalate. enterprise adds legal review step before Confirm.

legal: for joint-announces add partner PR OK + customer opt-in checkbox. also require NDA checklist if customer data in POC.

samir: pilot next 3 weeks. ops will publish short AE cheat sheet and a single webhook example. please react with :eyes: after you skim the Confluence doc I'll post.
